July 9, 2019

The Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, N.E.
Washington, DC 20543

Re: Dex Media, Inc. v. Click-to-Call Technologies, LP, No. 18-916

Dear Mr. Harris:

I represent the petitioner in the above-captioned case. On behalf of all 

parties, I write to request extensions of time on the merits briefs and any joint 
appendix in this case. (Petitioner will be filing a motion to dispense with the 
preparation of the joint appendix.) The briefing deadlines the parties request are as 
follows:

Brief for the petitioner (and any joint appendix):
Brief for the respondents:

August 22, 2019
October 7, 2019

Petitioners and both respondents have agreed to this schedule. If you need 

additional information, please let me know.

We appreciate your time and assistance.

Very truly yours,

Adam H. Charnes
